mapper.select: select op.opp_code as code, op.opp_name as name, co.name_ as type_primary, (select GROUP_CONCAT(d.name_ ORDER BY FIND_IN_SET(d.code_, op.opp_include_type) SEPARATOR ',') from sys_code d where d.type_ = 'opp_type' and FIND_IN_SET(d.code_, op.opp_include_type)) as type_secondary, op.cust_need as requirement, round(op.expect_contract_money, 4) as amount, round(op.month_income_contribution, 4) as monthly_contribution, op.opp_win_prob as sign_probability, DATE_FORMAT(op.sign_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as sign_date, co2.name_ as status, op.opp_data_reform as department, op.is_valid as is_valid, co3.name_ as product_solution from topp_opportunity op left join sys_code co on op.opp_type = co.code_ and co.type_ = 'opp_type' left join sys_code co2 on op.oppo_state = co2.code_ and co2.type_ = 'oppo_state' left join sys_code co3 on op.product_code = co3.code_ and co3.type_ = 'main_product' where op.is_Valid = 1 and op.cust_no = #{custNo} and (op.cust_manager_id = #{userDbId} or op.designer = #{userDbId} or op.creator = #{userDbId} or op.white_list like CONCAT('%,', #{userDbId}, ',%') or exists (select 1 from topp_member m where m.project_id = op.id_ and m.member_id = #{userDbId})) order by op.id_ desc
